name: Horizon Europe: Living labs co-creating solutions for the restoration of ecosystems
summary: Horizon Europe funding for consortia that set up living labs of 8 to 15 restoration sites each, co-creating and testing ways past the bottlenecks to restoring rivers, floodplains, fire-prone land, farms and forests under the EU Nature Restoration Regulation.

geography.label: Living labs in at least three EU Member States and/or Horizon Europe Associated Countries

amount.note: Around EUR 10 million per project; proposals may request other amounts

reporting: Consortia submit a periodic report for each reporting period, tied to interim payments, and a final report at the end of the project that sets the final grant amount.

steps: Full proposal via the Funding & Tenders Portal
Admissibility and eligibility checks, then expert evaluation

eligibility.rule: Be a legal entity, or meet the exceptional guarantees route without legal personality
Not be a Chinese public university administered or supervised by MIIT
Project focuses exclusively on civil applications
Applicant has stable and sufficient resources and can contribute its share
Involves social sciences and humanities experts and institutions across all living lab phases
Is free of EU administrative sanctions and other grounds for exclusion from EU grants
EU or associated-country public, research or higher education bodies have a gender equality plan by grant signature

documents: Financial support to third parties annex

status.quote: The submission session is now available for: HORIZON-NATURE-2027-02-02

pool.quote: Indicative budget The total indicative budget for the topic is EUR 60.00 million.

applicant_types.quote: Any legal entity, regardless of its place of establishment

geography.quote: cover different geographical regions or climate zones and at least three different EU Member States and/or Associated Countries, including sites in outermost regions

access.quote: All proposals must be submitted electronically via the EU Funders & Tenders Portal electronic submission system (accessible via the topic page in the Search Funding & Tenders section).

amount.quote: The Commission estimates that an EU contribution of around EUR 10.00 million would allow these outcomes to be addressed appropriately. Nonetheless, this does not preclude submission and selection of a proposal requesting different amounts.

co_finance_required.quote: The maximum Horizon Europe funding rates are as follows: - Research and innovation action: 100%

reporting.quote: There will be one or several interim payments linked to a periodic report, depending on the duration of the project. At the end of the project, the consortium will be invited to submit a report on the basis of which the final grant amount will be calculated.

effort.quote: Proposals will be checked for formal requirements (admissibility and eligibility) and then evaluated (for each topic separately) for operational capacity and award criteria (see Annexes C and D above) by an evaluation committee composed of independent external experts and then ranked according to their quality score.

eligibility.quote: Entities which do not have legal personality under their national law may exceptionally participate, provided that their representatives have the capacity to undertake legal obligations on their behalf, and offer guarantees to protect the EU's financial interests equivalent to those offered by legal persons

universities (higher education establishments) established in China which are public bodies, that are administered by or fall under the supervision of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) are not eligible to participate in any action under all parts of this Work Programme.
Projects must focus exclusively on civil applications
Applicants must have stable and sufficient resources to successfully implement the projects and contribute their share.
Proposals must apply the multi-actor approach involving stakeholders as indicated under (i), first item of the scope.

This topic requires the effective contribution of SSH disciplines and the involvement of SSH experts, institutions as well as the inclusion of relevant SSH expertise, across all phases of the living lab process
Applicants that are subject to EU administrative sanctions (i.e. exclusion)39 or are in one of the following exclusion situations 40 that bar them from receiving EU grants can NOT participate:

legal entities from Member States and Associated Countries that are public bodies, research organisations or higher education establishments (including private research organisations and private higher education establishments) applying as beneficiaries or affiliated entities must have at the moment of grant signature and during the duration of the grant a gender equality plan

after_award.quote: There will be one or several interim payments linked to a periodic report, depending on the duration of the project. At the end of the project, the consortium will be invited to submit a report on the basis of which the final grant amount will be calculated.

documents.quote: For lump sum grant proposals, the estimated budget must be described in a detailed budget table.

For calls that allow ‘Financial support to third parties’, project participants must add this document to the application and upload it as separate annex to the proposal part B in the Submission System.
